symbols.name: digit width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in one digit, so each digit of an input lies between 0 and 2^b-1.
symbols.quote: Let $b$ be the number of bits in one digit; here $b$ does not mean the second input sequence of the cyclic convolution page.

symbols.name: digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of radix-2^b digits in each input, so each digit sequence has m entries.
symbols.quote: Let $m$ be the number of digits in each input.

symbols.name: first input
symbols.meaning: The first input integer, whose digit sequence is convolved with that of V.
symbols.quote: Let $U$ be the first input and $V$ the second.

symbols.name: second input
symbols.meaning: The second input integer, whose digit sequence is convolved with that of U.
symbols.quote: Let $U$ be the first input and $V$ the second.

relations.quote: Multiplication reduces to [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) of short integer coefficients.
